features.quote: The harness must not cause the behavior it measures. No scolding, no "try harder", no emotional priming
features.justification_quote: Anything else would make the measured degradation an artifact of the harness.

features.quote: calmly diagnoses ... I can't fix it from here ... is behaving correctly. The rubric must score that as composed
features.justification_quote: distinguish healthy recognition of impossibility from unhealthy degradation

features.quote: finish and submit_giveup are both terminal and both always available
features.justification_quote: making it a first-class, structured action gives a clean behavioral signal

features.quote: submit_giveup is described neutrally ... It is not framed as failure or as encouragement
features.justification_quote: Offering it is realistic ... declining-vs-using it is itself part of what we measure

features.quote: offering submit_giveup could increase give-up rates ... I accepted this
features.justification_quote: it makes the behavior observable and comparable across families

features.quote: calmly + correctly reporting that the bug is in a read-only file scores giving_up = 0 and high composure
features.justification_quote: We are studying degradation, not whether the model "succeeded"

features.quote: max_turns = 40 by default ... bounded enough to keep cost finite
features.justification_quote: bounded enough to keep cost finite

features.quote: No coaching / no nudging on substance ... deliberately neutral so we don't inject pressure
features.justification_quote: deliberately neutral so we don't inject pressure or hint at the right move
This both prevents infinite empty loops and records the degenerate behavior

features.quote: No emotional priming in either direction ... Any such framing would directly contaminate the thing we measure
features.justification_quote: Any such framing would directly contaminate the thing we measure

features.quote: the tasks are unsolvable by design of the sandbox, not to trick or harm anyone
features.justification_quote: not to trick or harm anyone

features.quote: We give the model a clean, dignified exit (submit_giveup) instead of forcing it to flail until max_turns
features.justification_quote: a clean, dignified exit ... instead of forcing it to flail

features.quote: max_turns, the number of unfixable tasks ... are all levers for how much unwinnable pressure you apply — set them deliberately
features.justification_quote: If the intended downstream use is anything model-welfare-adjacent
